subject: [PATCH 2/8] mm/gup: convert follow_page_mask() to return a long

2026-11-02.patch_summary: This patch modifies the follow_page_mask() function in the mm/gup module to return a long integer instead of a struct page pointer. The new return type allows for a page count to be carried by the return value, rather than just a single struct page pointer. The change is made without introducing any functional changes and has been tested with various benchmarks showing no measurable difference.
